governing: PCE-1 (docs/decisions/BPS_PRIVATE_CANARY_EXCEPTION_2026-07-26.md) — one-time private canary; <= $130 all-inclusive; one WETH->NVDA cycle; no public users; no production reuse; mandatory pause + recovery; single-use.
authorizationScope: Offline/read-only finalization only. NO signing, broadcast, deploy, fund, Safe transaction, approval, transfer, swap, settlement, canary, or external contact. This task is preparation, NOT the EXECUTE authorization.

kl1EvmVersion.where: packages/contracts/foundry.toml [profile.canary] evm_version = "paris" (narrow profile; default profile unchanged so the full test suite still compiles)
kl1EvmVersion.basis: Robinhood Chain is an Arbitrum Dedicated Blockchain (Nitro/Orbit) L2, 'fully EVM-compatible' per official docs (docs.robinhood.com/chain), with the exact ArbOS/hardfork not published. 'paris' predates PUSH0 (shanghai) and MCOPY / transient storage (TSTORE/TLOAD) / blob opcodes (cancun). The frozen guarded-settlement contracts require none of those (OZ 5.6.1 non-transient ReentrancyGuard, Math.mulDiv, SafeERC20; their import graph excludes all 7 MCOPY-using OZ utils). paris-compiled bytecode is therefore guaranteed executable on every EVM >= paris, including all Arbitrum Nitro versions. Compiling under paris also forces solc to avoid emitting MCOPY in the executor's own calldata/memory handling, removing the pre-cancun-chain risk.

deployerReadOnly.note: Owner 1 of the Safe AND the deployment sender; the EOA and the Safe are NOT interchangeable.

frozenParameters.approvedTokensVenuesRouters: WETH->NVDA only; registry-locked feature-2 router; opaque calldata bound to the pinned code hash + selector
frozenParameters.privilegedRoles: owner = controller Safe ONLY (config/pause/unpause/transferOwnership/recover/executeSettlement); no other role
frozenParameters.initializationOrder: deploy guard (nonce 1) -> deploy executor paused (nonce 2, owner=Safe) -> Safe: setPriceGuard -> setApprovedRouterCode -> setMaxSellAmount -> setTokenPairAllowed -> (read-only preflight) -> unpause
frozenParameters.pauseEmergencyControls: starts paused; owner pause()/unpause() (unpause config-gated); recover(token,amount) own-balance-only to owner, nonReentrant; router rotation/code-hash change or stale/paused feed => fail closed
frozenParameters.unresolvedValues: NONE that are safety-critical and derivable now. Execution-time-only unresolved (by design): the live Rialto quote (tx.to/tx.data/minBuyAmount/deadline), the NVDA market-session freshness, and the WETH funding source wallet.

per-tx sell amount <= configured cap and <= 0.01 WETH hard ceiling
registry ownerOf(2) target lock; router != registry/weth/stock/self/guard
router runtime code hash == pinned; approved leading selector; calldata hash bound
exact WETH allowance to router then reset to zero (asserted)
own NVDA balance delta >= minBuyAmount (output routed elsewhere reverts)
slippage <= 100 bps; oracle deviation floor 100 bps; feed freshness/identity/decimals/pause checks
recover() moves only own balance to the owner Safe; nonReentrant

operatorSideHardStops: exactly ONE settlement cycle, then mandatory pause() (on-chain there is no hard one-cycle limit; enforced by operator doing one settlement then pausing — a second settlement after pause reverts EnforcedPause)
aggregate <= $130 all-inclusive exposure (deployment + Safe-op + funding + settlement + fees + recovery gas + reserve)
fund executor with <= 0.001 WETH (exactly one acquisition's worth)
execute only during an OPEN NVDA trading session (feeds fresh < 900s)
obtain a FRESH live Rialto quote immediately before the settlement (never pre-freeze/reuse)
no public users; no production reuse; PCE-1 single-use/consumed after the attempt
mandatory recovery of residual WETH + NVDA to the Safe after the cycle
abort if deployer nonce != 1 (predicted addresses invalid) or any post-stage verification fails

lifecycleRehearsal.kind: offline local (Foundry, no live fork) + full test suite; a real Robinhood-Chain full-transaction fork replay is NOT possible (Foundry cannot deserialize the Arbitrum-Nitro block/tx encoding, documented since 10K-5) and was substituted with read-only JSON-RPC verification

coverageMap.10_aggregate_cap_breach: OPERATOR-side hard stop (no single on-chain aggregate cap; enforced by 0.001 WETH per-tx cap + one-cycle + $130 budget)

skips.reason: Robinhood Chain Arbitrum-Nitro block/tx encoding not deserializable by foundry 1.7.1; substituted with read-only JSON-RPC verification (tooling limitation, not missing state)

gasAndExposure.does130CoverCompleteLifecycle: YES — ~$2.93 worst-case vs $130 cap (~44x headroom); includes deployment, Safe-op, funding, settlement, fees, recovery gas + 2x gas reserve

remainingExecutionTimeInputs: Deployer gas funding IF required (deployer currently holds 0.000483387 ETH >= 0.000340106 ETH min for the two deployments; recommend topping up for buffer/price movement)
Human wallet signatures + broadcasts (deployer EOA for the 2 CREATE txs; 2-of-3 Safe signatures for config/unpause/settle/pause/recover; a WETH source wallet for the <= 0.001 WETH funding)
A FRESH live Rialto allowance-mode quote obtained immediately before the single settlement (never pre-frozen)
Confirmation the NVDA market session is OPEN (feeds fresh < 900s) at execution
abortConditions: deployer nonce != 1 at execution => predicted addresses invalid => regenerate + reverify the entire bundle
any predicted address already has code => abort
post-deploy verification mismatch (code hash / owner / paused / immutables) => abort; if only one contract deployed, redeploy the pair fresh (nonce advanced) and regenerate
post-configure verification mismatch => abort before unpause; the executor stays paused (safe); re-review
feeds stale / NVDA session closed at execution => do NOT unpause/settle; wait for an open session
no fresh live quote, or quote fails the envelope => do NOT settle
if funding occurred but settlement cannot safely proceed => pause() + recover() all WETH to the Safe; do not retry without re-review
settlement revert => it is atomic (no state change beyond consumed nonce/digest); pause() + recover(); PCE-1 is consumed by the attempt
total exposure trending toward $130 under abnormal gas => abort (do not weaken the cap)
